metadata.title: RoadsideAssistance Vehicle Fault Symptom Dataset
metadata.description: Multi-category vehicle problem descriptions mapped to 5 core roadside assistance service categories plus uncertain/ambiguous queries.

schema.text: string, driver symptom description in natural language
schema.vehicle_type: string, optional vehicle context (car, motorbike, van, threeWheeler, truck)
schema.is_synthetic: boolean, false for survey-derived/real examples, true for synthetic augmentations

metadata.limitations: Synthetically augmented examples complement the survey baseline to cover diverse phrasing. Field testing and continuous validation on actual driver breakdown logs is recommended for production deployment.
